entities.summary: Rinchinnyamyn Amarjargal is a Mongolian politician and economist who served as the 21st Prime Minister of Mongolia from 30 July 1999 to 26 July 2000. He is a leading member of the Democratic Party. Rinchinnyamyn Amarjargal was a performers & entertainers from Ulaanbaatar (b. 1961-02-02, Ulaanbaatar). Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
